primaryChecks.text: But David had brought God’s ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which the LORD’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before the LORD’s tabernacle; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文に町名が明記され、神の箱をそこからエルサレムへ移したという場所として述べる。
